title: Toward a Scalable and Adaptive Evaluation Measure for Time Series Anomaly Detection
abstract: arXiv:2611.30385v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Time Series Anomaly Detection (TSAD) is a fundamental task for time series analytics. Unlike other domains, where anomaly detection mainly focuses on point-based anomalies, TSAD must also handle range-based anomalies. Nevertheless, TSAD methods are commonly evaluated with measures inherited from classification, such as Precision and Recall, which require a threshold, or with threshold-independent ones, such as AUC, which ignore the temporal aspect of anomalies. To address these issues, the Volume Under the Surface (VUS) measure scores detectors across all thresholds and a range of buffer lengths and has been widely adopted. However, VUS has two limitations. translated_title: 迈向一种可扩展且自适应的时间序列异常检测评估度量
translated_abstract: 时间序列异常检测是时间序列分析中的一项基础任务。与其他主要关注基于点异常的领域不同，TSAD还必须处理基于区间的异常。然而，TSAD方法通常使用从分类任务继承来的度量进行评估，例如需要阈值的精确率和召回率，或者使用与阈值无关的度量，例如忽略了异常时间特性的AUC。为了解决这些问题，曲面下体积度量在所有阈值和一系列缓冲长度范围内对检测器进行评分，并已被广泛采用。然而，VUS存在两个局限性。第一，VUS的计算开销很大，在870个TSB-AD时间序列上评估32个检测器需要7小时38分钟。第二，VUS对每个异常和每个检测器都应用相同的缓冲长度，这可能产生过于乐观的评分，从而阻碍对准确检测器的有效区分。
tldr: 该论文指出被广泛采用的时间序列异常检测评估度量VUS存在计算开销大以及对所有异常和检测器使用固定缓冲长度导致评分过于乐观的两大局限，旨在提出一种更可扩展且自适应的评估度量。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies two key limitations of the widely adopted VUS measure for time series anomaly detection—its high computational cost and its use of fixed buffer lengths for every anomaly and detector, which yields over-optimistic scores—and aims to propose a more scalable and adaptive evaluation measure.
